verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with multiple weighted variants (A/B/n) and positions itself as managing both feature flags and remote config. An independent community comparison confirms it supports remote configuration of arbitrary values alongside flags, which covers the core of going beyond booleans. A separate community remark that remote config is "less polished" is general sentiment, not a concrete contradiction, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. missing for 10: explicit documentation of typed values (strings, numbers, JSON) and how SDKs read them, detailed docs on remote config value setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps.
Flagsmith was one of the few options that supports remote configuration of arbitrary values alongside flags
serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag
